CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2452 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head b69ac5c1657df26fa3a9d973fbd851beca93a144. Bus nonce: 4a722016d2bcc2faa75204235021970d. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin b69ac5c1657df26fa3a9d973fbd851beca93a144`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge b69ac5c1657df26fa3a9d973fbd851beca93a144` or `Fix review: blocked b69ac5c1657df26fa3a9d973fbd851beca93a144 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4a722016d2bcc2faa75204235021970d`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2452 b69ac5c1657df26fa3a9d973fbd851beca93a144") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2452-4a722016`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 2 (R10-DEEPLINK-HANDLERS, closes #2317). Round 1 blocked on a census gap in tests/card.mjs: navigation seams the census did not refuse. The fixer widened the location sink (any member write plus reload, via document/top/parent/frames/window.window/self/defaultView), bound History and Navigation, recorded document.open/write/writeln, read meta http-equiv=refresh under all three quotings, and ran deferred timers before the read. The claimed results: 29 class plants are green at base and red at head; each new line has an X pair (X31LT1 stays red because the card's code mentions top, so X31LT2 on parent was added); NULL_no_plant rc=0; RD8, F1 and Y1 green; node tests/card.mjs 1259 ok 0 FAIL in about 2m42s. Use the finder's harness (tools/audit/seat/r10_deeplink_mutants.py) to re-run the plants and nulls. Adversarially look for any remaining navigation seam the census still misses (e.g. form submit/action, anchor click(), window.open, srcdoc/iframe, location via the Reflect/Proxy family). Say which round this is.
